texts.CatalogIntro: Browse published plans. Subscriptions are assigned by an administrator; online checkout is not available.
texts.BundleIntro: Bundles combine plans for different products. Each product subscription and expiration is independent.
texts.MineIntro: View your independent product subscriptions and immutable assignment history.
texts.DefaultPlanIntro: This product's default plan applies when you have no active subscription.
texts.DefaultEntitlementsIntro: These rights apply to products without an active subscription. They are not subscription assignments and have no assignment dates or history.
texts.LiveDefaultWarning: Default rights use the current plan values. Administrator edits, replacement or removal of the default take effect on your next query.
texts.DefaultFiltersIntro: This section has its own search, product filter and pagination. Assignment status and history filters do not apply. Select a product name to filter its default rights.
texts.NoDefaultEntitlements: No default rights match these filters. A product may have an active subscription or no configured default.
texts.Sort:Name: Name (A–Z)
texts.NoCatalogItems: No published items match these filters.
texts.SnapshotIntro: These values were captured at assignment. Later catalog changes do not change this snapshot.
texts.EffectiveIntro: This active assignment currently grants the entitlements below.
texts.IneffectiveIntro: This assignment is not active and grants no current entitlements. Its history is preserved below.
texts.Validation:InvalidFilter: The filters are invalid. Check the product, status, sorting and paging values.
